trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the first unhealthy production release; the most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc had only failed in staging, so it was not a candidate).
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions — no approval needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
3. **Verified recovery**: service is now healthy with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback action, and post-rollback status.
